audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the complete Community Center celebration, Morris confrontation, peaceful choice, community reminiscences, JojaMart boycott, and closing narration. Every spoken line, player response, award name, town and fair term, sale claim, memory, crab anecdote, civic argument, boycott call, and crowd reaction was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, completion conditions, fork destination, award payload, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. This leaves only non-Community-Center Town records and full-locale final audits pending.
